title: Work out a new word
instructions: Use the word parts and the sentence together, then choose the best answer.

parts.prompt: Because the instructions were so misleading, several students went to the wrong room. What does “misleading” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: Mis- means wrongly, and lead means show the way, so students went the wrong way.
choice_rationales.B: Speed of writing is not mentioned.
choice_rationales.D: Students read them and acted on them, so they could read them.

parts.hint: What did the students do after reading?
parts.correct_explanation: The parts suggest leading wrongly, and students went to the wrong room.
